jess: Heads-up — PR #18422 (kv-cache-fix) is green locally but CI is queued ~8h. Maintenance blackout 00:00 UTC tomorrow. Can someone nudge the queue or advise if we should rebase onto staging to avoid freeze?
alex: Link and job id?
jess: https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/18422  ci job: 98421
ci-bot: Job 98421 queued (pos 42). Est wait ~6h. No failures reported yet.
liam: If infra won't bump priority, a soft rebase to main might push it through faster. Any conflicts?
jess: No conflicts, tests pass locally. Only risk is the DB migration landing window — if we miss the pre-freeze slot we have to wait until after blackout.
nora: I can ping infra and the release ops channel. If we get priority we can land within the next 2h.
alex: What's the migration risk if it lands after the freeze? Rollback pain?
jess: It just delays the migration by a day — not catastrophic but blockers for a downstream feature. Prefer to land before freeze.
infra-bot: @nora requested priority for PR #18422. Manual priority bump granted for 2h window. Please trigger canary lane.
jess: Thanks — doing a soft rebase now, will push and request canary. pinging @alex and @liam for quick approval if CI green.
alex: +1, will give fast review on green.
liam: approving on sight, :thumbsup:
jess: pushed rebased branch and requested canary. Notifying release ops. Will update here once canary completes.
ci-bot: Canary job 98422 started.
